Maharashtra mandates Marathi in schools, threatens action for non-compliance

Maharashtra's Education Minister Dada Bhuse has announced that Marathi will be compulsory in all schools from Class 1 to 10. The government plans an inspection drive to ensure compliance, with schools violating the mandate facing potential cancellation of their recognition. The move aims to enforce the teaching of the Marathi language across the state's educational institutions.
